title: Fix split lookahead bias in _ev_split_correlated
description: player.py _ev_split_correlated evaluates hand 1 from deck1 (only cv1 removed) when it should use deck2 (both initial split cards removed). Matches the bug structure noted in the prior conversation summary. Combinatorial _ev_split already gets this right. Fix brings fast/finite solver split EV closer to combinatorial gold standard.
close_reason: Implemented as mode=auto routing instead of in-place fix to _ev_split_correlated. Cross-mode comparison showed 88% of the fast-vs-combinatorial gap is from static dealer probs, not the split lookahead, so routing to combinatorial/exact for small decks (where the bias matters) was higher leverage than patching _ev_split_correlated.

title: parallel sim: SolverStrategy DS sentinel breaks across pickle
description: BasicStrategy._DOUBLE_STAND = object() loses identity when SolverStrategy is pickled to worker processes. The 'is' check at strategy.py:178 fails, so DS cells fall through to the default HIT branch. Confirmed: 5M-round parallel run with --solver_strategy gives HE 16-23 bp higher than solver predicts (3-sigma above CI), while single-CPU run agrees with solver within noise. Fix: switch sentinel to a pickle-stable value (string) and use == comparison.

title: Chase 7-bp 1-deck H17 gap to WoO Optimal
description: TestWoOReference shows 7.3 bp gap at 1-deck H17 (we under-estimate HE). All other rule sets match within sub-bp. Pattern is 1-deck AND H17, suggests composition-handling bug amplified by 1-deck composition shifts plus H17 dealer-hit sensitivity. Top hypothesis: _ev_split lookahead does not account for hand-1's play depleting the deck before hand-2 is evaluated.
close_reason: 3-stage investigation ruled out memoization, per-action EV calculation (matches independent brute force exactly), and split-EV path-dependence (would move HE in wrong direction). Per-action EVs verified correct under our model via independent brute force at 13 cells (1e-10 agreement). The 7-bp gap to WoO Optimal must come from an algorithmic methodology difference not exposed at the per-state level. Without WoO source, no further bisection is possible. Gap is small, well below the 10-bp test tolerance, and shrinks to sub-bp at 2+ decks. Documented findings in TestWoOReference docstring.
